evidence_excerpts: The signal restoration built in to every logic gate allows simple tuning to restore desired circuit behaviour, compensating for the impurity of molecules.
It is also necessary to eliminate leak reactions in DNA circuits and to improve the building blocks such that they are substantially less sensitive to synthesis errors and stoichiometry errors.
text: Signal restoration and component tuning compensate for impurity in unpurified seesaw circuits, although leak reactions and sensitivity to synthesis and stoichiometry errors remain limiting concerns.
